people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.
translations.bsb: In all, twelve cities were allotted to the clans of Merari, the remaining Levite clans.
translations.kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
translations.asv: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites; and their lot was twelve cities.
